name: Lemon Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: full cups of sifted flour
ingredients.originalText: four full cups of sifted flour

ingredients.name: the grated peel and juice of a lemon
ingredients.originalText: the grated peel and juice of a lemon

instructions.text: Mix together three teacupfuls of sugar and one cupful of butter.
Dissolve a level teaspoonful of soda in a cup of sweet milk and add.
Add four full cups of sifted flour.
Add the grated peel and juice of a lemon, the juice to be added the very last.
When cold ice with lemon icing and cut into squares.

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix together three teacupfuls of sugar and one cupful of butter.
2. Add five eggs.
3. Dissolve a level teaspoonful of soda in a cup of sweet milk and add.
4. Add four full cups of sifted flour.
5. Add the grated peel and juice of a lemon, the juice to be added the very last.
6. Bake in two shallow tins.
7. When cold ice with lemon icing and cut into squares.
